claims.summary: Finish-package results carry the current CourseGraph back to the export panel, and ZIP downloads use that finish graph instead of a potentially stale prop.
CourseIR fallback rows without URL/DOI/license proof are quarantined into sourceReviewRows and SOURCE_REPORT.md review notes instead of polluting trusted sourceLedger proof.
The deep grader still flags review-only source rows as citation debt; the patch changes the evidence class, not the standard.
Assignment academic-integrity prose no longer begins with Integrity for, removing the deterministic X:X echo exposed in the audited Research Methods assignment brief.

carryForward.next: Build a real ResearchSession planner that researches course concepts once, caches a trusted ledger, and compiles many deliverables without browsing per artifact.
Bridge CourseIR atom sourceRefs directly to retrieved lesson resources so future packages can replace review-only fallback rows with trusted source rows.
Add semantic claim support checks for high-risk factual anchors using cached snippets or quote anchors.
